【原视频简介】
I built a massive Minecraft cloud castle in my survival world to prepare for the upcoming Dappled Forest update.

The new update is bringing colorful additions like wool slabs, stairs, and cushions to the game. My Coral Palace is over 10,000 blocks away from my base and still disconnected from the Nether hub, so I needed a more efficient solution. This build serves as a central hub for three major farms I will need to gather resources for the new content.

Everything here is done freehand in my Hardcore Minecraft survival building world without the use of Litematica. I am walking through the construction process today and even showing off a secret feature I included in the design. If you enjoy large-scale projects and efficient Minecraft farm design, stick around for the build tour.

Subscribe to follow along with the rest of my forever world projects.
